2e21dde48be974440193a00e7b6441e6a9ca1b9a.summary: Part 1 of an analysis of the Panda Banker banking trojan by Crovax, published 2021-08-26. The malware shares code with Zeus, injects code into web browsers to steal banking and credit card credentials, uses anti-analysis and obfuscation, and deletes itself when it detects analysis tools. Memory analysis shows an unknown process spawning data_1.exe. Behavioural and reverse engineering findings are deferred to part 2.

sectors.q: It’s known to inject code into the users web browser and attempt to steal banking/credit card credentials.
